description: The line plot illustrates the Mean Reciprocal Rank at position 10 (MRR@10) performance of different DPR (Dense Passage Retrieval) variants as a function of the number of queries used during inference, ranging from 1 to 10. The x-axis, labeled "Number of queries used during inference (S)", is a linear scale with integer values from 1 to 10. The y-axis, labeled "MRR@10", is a linear scale ranging from 33.0 to 36.0. Four distinct models are compared: "DPR w/o query" (black solid line), "DPR w/ corpus expansion" (red solid line with circular markers), "DPR w/ document expansion" (green solid line with triangular markers), and "DPR w/ asymmetric expansion" (blue solid line with star markers). The black line remains nearly constant at a value of approximately 34.2 across all query counts. The red line starts at approximately 35.1 and steadily increases to about 35.8. The green line begins at around 34.7 and shows a slight decline to approximately 34.7. The blue line starts at about 34.6, rises to a peak of approximately 35.0 at 2 queries, then generally declines to around 34.4 by 10 queries.
